verses.text: A Maskil of Asaph. O God, why have You rejected [us] forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.textZh: （亞薩的訓誨詩。）神啊，你為何永遠丟棄我們呢？你為何向你草場的羊發怒，如煙冒出呢？

verses.text: Remember Your congregation, which You have purchased of old, Which You have redeemed to be the tribe of Your inheritance; [And] this Mount Zion, where You have dwelt.
verses.textZh: 求你記念你古時所得來的會眾，就是你所贖﹔作你產業支派的，並記念你向來所居住的錫安山。

verses.text: Turn Your footsteps toward the perpetual ruins; The enemy has damaged everything within the sanctuary.
verses.textZh: 求你舉步去看那日久荒涼之地，仇敵在聖所中所行的一切惡事。

verses.text: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of Your meeting place; They have set up their own standards for signs.
verses.textZh: 你的敵人在你會中吼叫；他們豎了自己的旗為記號。

verses.text: It seems as if one had lifted up [His] axe in a forest of trees.
verses.textZh: 他們好像人揚起斧子，砍伐林中的樹。

verses.text: And now all its carved work They smash with hatchet and hammers.
verses.textZh: 聖所中一切雕刻的，他們現在用斧子錘子打壞了。

verses.text: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; They have defiled the dwelling place of Your name.
verses.textZh: 他們用火焚燒你的聖所，褻瀆你名的居所，拆毀到地。

verses.text: They said in their heart, 'Let us completely subdue them.' They have burned all the meeting places of God in the land.
verses.textZh: 他們心裡說：我們要盡行毀滅；他們就在遍地把神的會所都燒燬了。

verses.text: We do not see our signs; There is no longer any prophet, Nor is there any among us who knows how long.
verses.textZh: 我們不見我們的標幟，不再有先知；我們內中也沒有人知道這災禍要到幾時呢！

verses.text: How long, O God, will the adversary revile, [And] the enemy spurn Your name forever?
verses.textZh: 神啊，敵人辱罵要到幾時呢？仇敵褻瀆你的名要到永遠麼？

verses.text: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? From within Your bosom, destroy [them]!
verses.textZh: 你為甚麼縮回你的右手？求你從懷中伸出來，毀滅他們。

verses.text: Yet God is my king from of old, Who works deeds of deliverance in the midst of the earth.
verses.textZh: 神自古以來為我的王，在地上施行拯救。

verses.text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.textZh: 你曾用能力將海分開，將水中大魚的頭打破。

verses.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You gave him as food for the creatures of the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 你曾砸碎鱷魚的頭，把他給曠野的禽獸（禽獸：原文是民）為食物。

verses.text: You broke open springs and torrents; You dried up ever-flowing streams.
verses.textZh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河；你使長流的江河乾了。

verses.text: Yours is the day, Yours also is the night; You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.textZh: 白晝屬你，黑夜也屬你；亮光和日頭是你所預備的。

verses.text: You have established all the boundaries of the earth; You have made summer and winter.
verses.textZh: 地的一切疆界是你所立的；夏天和冬天是你所定的。

verses.text: Remember this, O LORD, that the enemy has reviled, And a foolish people has spurned Your name.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，仇敵辱罵，愚頑民褻瀆了你的名，求你記念這事。

verses.text: Do not deliver the soul of Your turtledove to the wild beast; Do not forget the life of Your afflicted forever.
verses.textZh: 不要將你斑鳩的性命交給野獸；不要永遠忘記你困苦人的性命。

verses.text: Consider the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence.
verses.textZh: 求你顧念所立的約，因為地上黑暗之處都滿了強暴的居所。

verses.text: Let not the oppressed return dishonored; Let the afflicted and needy praise Your name.
verses.textZh: 不要叫受欺壓的人蒙羞回去；要叫困苦窮乏的人讚美你的名。

verses.text: Arise, O God, [and] plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish man reproaches You all day long.
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你起來為自己伸訴！要記念愚頑人怎樣終日辱罵你。

verses.text: Do not forget the voice of Your adversaries, The uproar of those who rise against You which ascends continually.
verses.textZh: 不要忘記你敵人的聲音；那起來敵你之人的喧嘩時常上升。
